summary: Feature 'Convert Pre-iscrizione → Iscrizione via invito genitore' fully verified end-to-end on frontend (admin + public form). All 3 UI scenarios passed. Backend endpoints POST /api/preseason/responses/{id}/invite and POST /api/preseason/public/{id}/respond return 200 with correct payloads. Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView / RN issues: none new detected. NOTE: testID attributes declared as `data-testid` prop on RN components (TextInput/TouchableOpacity) are stripped by React Native Web at render time — visible testIDs on DOM only appear on native HTML elements (e.g. `<input type='date'>`). This does not block the feature but hampers automated tests that rely on data-testid selectors. Tests were executed using text/placeholder selectors as workaround.

react_native_issues.issue: The whole /app/frontend/app/admin/preseason.tsx and /app/frontend/app/preseason/[id].tsx pass 'data-testid=...' as a prop to React Native TextInput/TouchableOpacity. React Native Web only forwards the standard 'testID' prop (which is mapped to data-testid on DOM). Result: the specific testIDs required by the review (preseason-quick-invite-<id>, preseason-invite-email, preseason-invite-send, preseason-invite-btn, preseason-email-parent, preseason-first-name, preseason-last-name, preseason-birth-date-native, view-responses-<id>) are NOT present in the rendered DOM. Only 'preseason-birth-date' (native <input type=date>) is present. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/preseason.tsx:864, 1135, 1170, 1188, 1400, and /app/frontend/app/preseason/[id].tsx:277, 281, 297, 316. Fix: rename the prop from 'data-testid' to 'testID' on RN components (keep 'data-testid' only for real HTML elements like <input>).

action_items: OPTIONAL: rename `data-testid` → `testID` on RN components in /app/frontend/app/admin/preseason.tsx and /app/frontend/app/preseason/[id].tsx to allow selector-based UI automation. Rebuild expo export afterwards.
